title: Basic tone that adapts to the picture
objective: Make Basic's Highlights, Shadows and Whites act on a RAW photograph's scene values relative to its development's scene white, and Blacks, Contrast, Vibrance and Saturation after the Look, so one strength per value fits Lightroom Classic's charts and photographs within A8, as docs/design/basic-local-tone.md specifies.
context_summary: Planned from docs/design/basic-local-tone.md, a level C change (A1, A8) of the Lightroom alignment plan's TASK-006, whose study (cargo xtask lr-align tone-study) measured Lightroom's exports only (A4). The owner took the design's four recommended answers on 2026-10-16 (global scene-white operator, Blacks/Contrast/Vibrance/Saturation after the Look on RAW, the development's scene white, Whites' re-stretch left to a later study) and authorized the plan. Basic stays one layer and one payload; its format rises from 3 to 4 and format 3 layers and presets are refused. Both parts are pointwise in the fused colour run: no halo, scratch, GPU window or staged sweep changes. This Linux host has no Metal; GPU evidence comes from the M4 in TASK-006. Rounds and originals are read-only.

tasks.description: Freeze the reference for the split Basic tone: the scene part (Whites, Shadows, Highlights in the scene-white domain c x W_e, with c_H = 3 and c_S = 2) and the rendered part (Blacks, Contrast, then Vibrance and Saturation), the scene white's definition, and the JPEG path, with exact fixtures and a dense monotonicity proof for each part.
extra_context: Promote the study's curves from crates/luxforge-reference/src/local_tone.rs into the frozen Basic tone reference; the base, guided and Levels prototypes stay study code unless the owner chooses the local option.

The scene white: block means to at most 0.25 MP, then the exact order statistic at floor(0.999 (n - 1)) of their linear luminance, deterministic and equal to the reference bit for bit (recorded choice). W_e is W scaled by Exposure's gain and by Basic's white balance gain on a neutral grey.
Whites and Blacks no longer share one endpoint remap or its gap clamp; each part is monotone on its own, proved densely as basic-tone.md does today, and values past the domain's white pass through.
On a rendered input the domain is today's (c x W_e = 1) and the order is Whites, Shadows, Highlights, Blacks, Contrast, Vibrance/Saturation.

tasks.description: Compute the development's scene white once on the source worker when a RAW photograph is developed, keep it with the prepared development, and pass it to colour compilation through CompileStage.
extra_context: It is a property of the development, not of the stage: independent of the crop and of every layer, never recomputed on a drag, never on the catalog owner or UI thread.
A rendered or derived source (JPEG, HDR merge) has none; compilation then takes the rendered path.

Charge its cost to the development path and measure it at 24 and 60 MP when timing runs are due; until then answer the performance checklist with its bounds (one pass and a selection over at most 2^18 means).

tasks.description: Let a colour operation carry a rendered tail that the registry places directly after the stack's rendering layer (the Look) when one follows on a scene-referred stack, and otherwise directly after the layer's own units, with the layer's mask on both parts, in the same fused colour run on the CPU and the GPU plan.
extra_context: One layer, one payload, one history entry: no second Basic layer (rejected in the design).
Point queries through a layer with a tail stay O(layers) and never rasterize; the neutral picker still reads the stage before the layer.
No new program boundary: both parts stay in the fused colour run, so halo, scratch, GPU window and staged sweeps are unchanged.

acceptance_criteria: Highlights within A8 jointly from -100 to +50 and on photographs at every value; charts at +75/+100 no worse than 2.2/3.0.
Shadows within A8 at every value; Blacks within A8 from -50 to +100 and no worse than 2.2/2.6 at -75/-100.

Exposure + Highlights within A8; Contrast + Blacks at most 5.0 and Contrast + Whites at most 6.5; Exposure + Whites no worse than 5.9 beyond the Whites +100 re-stretch; Contrast, Whites, Vibrance and Saturation on the charts no worse than today.
